description: The gasless fee rule both clients share: maxPriorityFeePerGas = min(tip, priorityFeeCeiling); maxFeePerGas = min(2 x base + priority, maxFeeCeiling); refused (gas_above_paymaster_ceiling) only when base + priority > maxFeeCeiling. Asserted by zkapi-clientd (selectGaslessFees, gasless_test.go) and the SDK (selectFees, sdk/test/zkapi-gasless.test.mjs). Every value is wei per gas, as a decimal string. maxFeeCeiling 100 gwei, priorityFeeCeiling 5 gwei unless a case says otherwise.

cases.name: tip capped by the priority ceiling
2 x base + tip one wei below the ceiling
2 x base + tip at the ceiling
2 x base + tip one wei above the ceiling: capped
2 x base + tip far above, base + tip below the ceiling: capped
base + tip one wei below the ceiling
base + tip one wei above the ceiling: refused
the capped tip decides: base + capped tip at the ceiling
the capped tip decides: base + capped tip one wei above
base fee alone above the ceiling
a tight ceiling: tip at the priority ceiling equal to the max-fee ceiling
a tight ceiling: one wei of base fee over it
